name: cavemio-multi-select
title: Multi-select
description: Several choices from a short list: the pill names them ("Design, Sales +2"), the list rises off it with ticks that draw, and it stays open while you pick.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Placement, presence and dismissal come from floating.ts, shared with tooltip, popover and the menus.
- For long or remote lists searched first, use combobox.
- Reduced motion: the list and ticks change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.
